changelog: - **No no-op stage-history rows** (#934). Every path that writes a `StatusChange` now builds it through `statusChangeData()` in `src/lib/stageChange.ts`, which refuses a row whose `fromStatus` equals its `toStatus` — including the bulk "advance stage" action and the demo seeder, neither of which had the check. A same-stage write stays a successful no-op rather than becoming a 400. `prisma/backfill-noop-status-changes.mjs` (idempotent, registered in `infra/deploy-prod.sh` and `infra/server/topic-deploy.sh`) deletes the rows already in the table; hiding them in the UI was never enough, because the stage clock (`stageEnteredAt`) and the aging report read the table, not the rendered list.

en: Stage history no longer shows "moves" that went nowhere, and the ones already recorded have been cleaned up.
"Days in stage" and the time-in-stage report are accurate again: a phantom entry can no longer restart a candidate's stage clock.
tr: Aşama geçmişinde artık aynı aşamadan aynı aşamaya "geçiş" kayıtları görünmüyor; daha önce yazılmış olanlar da temizlendi.
"Aşamada geçen gün" ve aşama süresi raporu yeniden doğru: sahte bir kayıt artık adayın aşama sayacını sıfırlayamıyor.
de: Der Stufenverlauf zeigt keine "Wechsel" mehr, bei denen sich nichts geändert hat; bereits erfasste Einträge wurden entfernt.
"Tage in der Stufe" und der Verweildauer-Bericht stimmen wieder: ein Scheineintrag kann die Stufenuhr einer Kandidatin nicht mehr zurücksetzen.
